name: RawTrampis
description:
RawTrampis Pro v4.4.0 is Trampis’ Geometry Dash practice and gameplay toolkit, built for a responsive, customizable interface and clear in-game feedback. This release improves live search, theme selection, keybind management, configuration profiles, and the home tab.

OPENING AND NAVIGATION
Press Ctrl+N to open or close the menu; the shortcut can be changed in Keybinds. The menu is organized into movable category panels. Scroll within a panel to browse its controls, and use a feature’s settings arrow for supported options. Search across feature names, descriptions, and IDs: matches are highlighted while unrelated controls are subdued, so results remain visible in context. Clear Search restores the normal appearance.

THEMES AND APPEARANCE
Choose from RawTrampis Blue, Nona, Nona Lux, Octavus, Septima, Sextus, Festive, Genesis, Catppuccin, Mint, Purple Rain, Platypus, Barbie, Navy, Cyanish, 7up, RawTrampis Blue, Arctic, Aurora, Cyber, Emerald, Flame, Sunset, Rose, Catppuccin Macchiato, Gruvbox, MegaHack, MegaOverlay, and OpenHack. The theme menu uses a spaced, scrollable list with an paired main-color and accent-color previews for each palette. Changing colors preserves your active renderer and layout. Dropdown sizing scales with your UI scale, theme choices follow the MegaHack palette order, and each panel remains movable after you arrange it. Bundled themes enable the animated background blur where the selected renderer and graphics path support it. Interface settings include scale, font, spacing, blur, and animation controls. The home tab offers a one-click return to RawTrampis Blue.

CONFIGURATION PROFILES
Enter a profile name and choose Save Profile to store the current configuration in the mod’s profile folder. Load Profile applies a previously saved profile with the same name and notifies registered feature callbacks so live states can update immediately. Names are restricted to safe filename characters. Profiles are useful for keeping separate practice, recording, or presentation setups.

KEYBINDS
Right-click a feature or use Shift-click to manage its keybind. Existing bindings show the current key and provide separate Change Keybind and Remove Keybind actions. Add Keybind makes a feature bindable. In the Keybinds panel, click a binding’s key field, press the desired key combination, and release it to confirm; Escape cancels capture. A brief confirmation appears after assignment.

CATEGORIES AND TOOLS
Global groups general gameplay and session tools such as audio, speed, display-rate, cursor, list, and safety controls. Level contains level-specific practice, progress, pause, coin, trigger, and visual tools. Player contains Noclip and movement, click, jump, trail, and effect features. Bot provides automation, replay, and practice helpers. Creator contains editor-oriented tools. Labels includes configurable on-screen information and the optional cheat indicator. Shortcuts offers quick actions. Keybinds manages the menu shortcut and supported feature bindings. Interface controls presentation and accessibility. Internal Recorder provides recording and replay controls when its optional integration is present. Category contents and settings can vary by platform and optional dependencies.

FEATURE SETTINGS AND PRACTICE
Supported features expose relevant settings such as keybinds, thresholds, modes, display behavior, and gameplay conditions. Noclip is disabled by default and uses hazard-focused collision handling so ordinary platforms remain solid. The cheat indicator is optional and stays hidden unless enabled. Some simple visual toggles do not need additional settings. Settings and feature states are persisted according to their configuration behavior.

COMPATIBILITY AND RESPONSIBLE USE
The current target is Geometry Dash 2.2081 with Geode 5.11.2. Game, Geode, graphics-driver, or third-party mod updates can affect compatibility. Gameplay tools may alter movement, timing, progression, or displayed results. Use them where permitted; assisted attempts may not qualify for records or leaderboards.
